description: One record per Google Maps place: place identity and listing details, open/closed status, coordinates and local time, hourly Popular Times and live busyness when Google serves them, the newest reviews with closure mentions, run-to-run monitoring signals and, when enabled, records for places that could not be retrieved. Google often serves signed-out sessions a limited view without Popular Times; those places are returned as basic records with dataStatus=limited_view, popularTimesAvailable=false and limitedViewReason=google_signin_required, never with invented busyness.

closureSignals.description: Per place: listing status, live reading status and live/usual ratio, review recency, closure mentions in the newest reviews and run-to-run monitoring signals.
closureSignals.title: Closure signals view

liveMonitoring.description: Compact table for monitoring: live busyness vs the usual level, live label, open status, listing status and the reason for any unavailable place.
liveMonitoring.title: Live monitoring view

popularTimes.description: All records: place identity, listing details, open status, coordinates and local time; hourly busyness per day and live/usual busyness when available; and an explicit dataStatus/limitedViewReason when Google serves its limited view.
popularTimes.title: Place data and Popular Times records

title: Google Maps Place Data & Popular Times (When Available) Output
